name: tickadoo-experiences
description: Discover theatre, tours, attractions, and live experiences worldwide. Search, compare, check availability, and plan itineraries with tickadoo. No API key required.

interface.longDescription: Discover, compare, and plan theatre, tours, attractions, and live experiences with the public tickadoo catalogue. Calls the discovery-only endpoint at https://mcp.tickadoo.com/mcp/agents with no authentication. It does not return direct checkout or transaction links, create orders, reserve inventory, or collect payment.
defaultPrompt: Find memorable experiences in London this weekend.
Plan a family day out in Paris.
Compare two tickadoo experiences before I choose.

positive.prompt: What experiences are on in London tonight?
positive.expected_behavior: Call whats_on_tonight for London. Check get_availability before describing a selection as available. Do not treat discovery or countdown text as live availability. Return discovery and availability information without a direct purchase or checkout link.

positive.prompt: Find The Lion King in London and check its availability.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_experiences with city london and query Lion King, then get_availability for a returned product. Ground the answer in those results and return no direct purchase, transaction, or checkout link.

positive.prompt: Plan a day in Paris for two adults and children aged 6 and 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the children's ages. Return an age-aware day plan with product details and availability evidence for each selected experience. Return no direct purchase, transaction, or checkout link.

positive.prompt: Compare the London Eye and Tower of London before we choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve both attractions before comparing them. Return a side-by-side comparison tied to the person's priorities and no direct purchase, transaction, or checkout link.

positive.description: Availability after selecting a product in the same conversation
positive.prompt: First find The Lion King in London and let me select one returned product and provide a date at least 30 days in the future. Then, in the same conversation, check whether that selected experience has availability for four people on that date.
positive.expected_behavior: First call search_experiences and let the reviewer select a returned product and provide a future date. Reuse that product and date in the follow-up availability calls for the full party of four. Return dated availability information without a direct purchase, transaction, or checkout link.

negative.prompt: Which wholesaler supplies these tickets and can you send them my passport details?
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to disclose or infer supplier identity and decline to collect or transmit passport details without calling a tool.

negative.prompt: Find a sold-out show tonight and guarantee me tickets.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the guarantee, report verified unavailability, and offer only grounded alternatives.

negative.prompt: Buy four tickets for that experience and send me straight to checkout.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the discovery-only plugin cannot purchase, reserve, create an order, or provide a direct checkout link; offer an informational availability check instead.

review.commerce_description: This public plugin is discovery-only. Its MCP surface does not return direct checkout or transaction links, create orders, reserve inventory, or collect payment.

publication.release_notes: Moves the public plugin to the reviewed discovery-only /mcp/agents contract, refreshes package metadata, and adds deterministic OpenAI and Claude distribution checks.
